name: Off the Scale
description: Two cards beyond the numbers. The Backflip Bat (-1) turns the round upside down, so the lowest card wins. The Galaxy Goldfish (∞) beats every number and calls the showdown at once when played. House design, balance untested.

add.name: Backflip Bat
add.text: When this card is put face up in front of anyone, the round turns upside down: the lowest card wins the showdown.

onDiscard.text: The round turns upside down! The lowest card wins the showdown.

add.name: Galaxy Goldfish
add.text: Higher than any number. If you play it, the showdown happens right now, before anyone draws again.

upsideDown.label: Upside down
upsideDown.text: The lowest card wins the showdown.
